responses: Hi! I'm the HPC cluster assistant. How can I help you?

patterns: how do I submit a job
run a script on the cluster
responses: Create a SLURM script and submit it with: sbatch my_script.sh
You can contact the HPC support team at support@hpc.edu
Check the documentation at https://hpc.edu/docs for more information.

patterns: how do I check my job status
responses: Use the command: squeue -u your_username to check the status of your jobs.

patterns: how do I cancel a job
responses: Use the command: scancel job_id to cancel a specific job.
Goodbye! If you have more questions, feel free to ask.
Please check your SLURM script for errors and ensure you have the correct permissions.

patterns: how do I load a module
responses: Use the command: module load module_name to load the desired software module.

patterns: how do I see available modules
responses: Use the command: module avail to see a list of available software modules.

patterns: how do I connect to the cluster
responses: You can connect to the HPC cluster using SSH: ssh username@cluster_address
